Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary

evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 25% of total value. 7. Purchase Preference (Centre) Indian suppliers of this item are not allowed to participate and/ or compete in procurement by some foreign governments. Bidders / products from such countries are not eligible / not allowed to participate in this bid in terms of clause 1 (d) of Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017 8. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 9. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text-based ATC Clauses 1. Type of inspection: - Post Dispatch inspection Successful L-1 seller should quote only FSSAI/AGMARK/ISI certified products in bid, in case any product of FSSAI/AGMARK/ISI certified products is not available, the product will be got tested from NABL accredite d Lab. All bidders must quote rate for Dry, Special ration items of only FSSAI/AGMARK/ISI certified products in bid details of which should be filled in BOQ/ Excel Sheet. a) After Award of Contract: - Successful Bidders shall submit one set of ration samples in respe ct of each consignee to the Buyer. The buyer will check the items through BOOs and sent it to consignee lo cations after giving approval to the L-1 firm as mentioned in the bid before commencement of supply. b) All samples required shall be supplied by the firm free of cost and shall not be reimbursed by buy er to them at any point of the time. 2. Post-Receipt inspection: - Yes, by the Board of Officers/Officials of SSB at Consignee location. The s ubsequent supplies will be checked by comparing the each item with ‘Accepted Sample’ and the decision r egarding acceptance of the supply thereof shall be final. 3. In order to maintain quality in the supply of approved & NABL accredited Lab tested ration items, the u nits placing demand with the successful bidder shall also draw samples of supplies on a random basis from each ration item delivered at their respective locations, and keep them in sealed/tamper proof packets, dul y signed by both the Coy Commander/BOP Commander and the supplier/representative of supplier. In cas

e of any complaints, these randomly preserved samples of food items from the current lot shall be subject ed to tests from NABL accredited Lab again. In case of adverse findings, the cost of test shall be borne by t he firm. If the samples fail to pass test from NABL accredited Lab, then the Performance Guarantee of the s aid vendor shall be liable to be forfeited. 4. The samples of each item will be preserved by Consignee location and subsequent supply will be chec ked by comparing the same with the samples accepted. 5. The packed ration items supplied under the contract must confirm to FSSAI specification prescribed an d shall perform according to the said specification in any climate and under all conditions of storage and m ovement. 6. All ration items, wherever applicable, should be as per standard norms of FSSAI/AGMARK/ISI. The items should be on the latest lot of manufacture, conforming to the current production standard and should be s howing manufacture date and expiry date. 7. Scope of Supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Only supply of Goods up to the consigne e locations. 8. Form of EMD - Bidders shall submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of the Com mandant, 11 Bn, SSB, Didihat, SBI, Didihat Pithoragarh (IFSC- SBIN0001385, Uttarakhand Pin- 262551. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days after Bid Opening date which will be handed over to commandant 11 Bn for further course of action. 9. Form of ePBG- Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in favour of the Commandant , 11 Bn, SSB, Didihat, SBI, Didihat Pithoragarh (IFSC- SBIN0001385, Uttarakhand Pin-262551 wi thin 15 days after award of contract. 10. Transportation up to the Consignee location and unloading along with Stacking at the Consignee locat ion at designated storage point will be the responsibility of the seller and the seller shall bear all charges. C arrying/freight charges/ponies/porter charges if any shall be borne by the seller at his own risk and expens es up to the consignee location. 11. Packing Material: -The Items will be supplied by the successful bidder in its original packing material a nd the packing material will not be returned. Weight of packing material will not be included in quantity su pplied and only net weight of the items will be counted. The packing should be of standardized weights of appropriate size. Items will not be accepted in non-standardized weights. 12. The actual quantity of ration may decrease or increase of what placed in BoQ supply option at the tim e of placement of Bid/Contract. The successful bidder will complete its first supply after approval of deposit ed sample and on approval for bulk supply as per first staggered of contact delivery period will be counted from the date of intimation of approval of bulk supply. Subsequently supply in terms of DP and quantity ma y be changed by the consignee, which will be communicated to the seller through Email/Fax as per actual requirement (on need basis) of consignee. So quantity & delivery period placed via E-mail/Fax mode will s upersede the quantity & period placed in BoQ supply. Once such supply order is placed, it will be the respo nsibility of the seller to supply stores as per the item demanded within delivery period mentioned in supply order placed via E-mail/Fax. 13. For fresh vegetables, fresh fruits, milk & dairy products, meat, poultry, fish, millets and mustard oil, th e actual quantity to be procured from the successful bidder shall depend upon the availability and satisfactory supply from the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC, as applic able. The Buyer shall ordinarily procure these items from the designated sources and shall place demand u pon the successful GeM bidder only in the event of failure, non-availability, short supply, delayed supply or unacceptable quality of supply from the designated source. Accordingly, the estimated quantities mention ed in the BOQ shall not constitute any guaranteed quantity or commitment of procurement from the succe

ssful bidder 14. Timeline for execution of supply a) For Dry Ration items:- After receiving the supply order, Seller required to delivered the store at con signee location within a week of placing supply order. b) For Fresh Ration items :- After receiving the supply order, Seller required to delivered the store at c onsignee location within three days in every week. 15. Procurement from Designated Cooperative/Institutional Sources. i) The Buyer/Consignee intends to procure certain ration items from designated Cooperative Societies/Coo perative Institutions and other identified institutional sources through separate Memorandum of Understan ding (MoU)/arrangement, as applicable, during the currency of the contract. ii) The following items shall ordinarily be procured from the designated sources: a) Fresh vegetables, fresh fruits and milk & dairy products – from eligible local Cooperative Societies/Coop erative Institutions through MoU. b) Meat, poultry and fish – from eligible Cooperative Societies/Cooperative Institutions through MoU. c) Millets – from NAFED (National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India Ltd.), through the prescribed procurement arrangement. d) Mustard oil – from KVIC (Khadi and Village Industries Commission), through the prescribed procurement arrangement. iii) The successful bidder under this GeM contract shall act as a standby/alternate supplier for the aforesaid items covered in the BOQ. The Buyer/Consignee shall have the right to place demand upon the s uccessful bidder whenever the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC, as app licable, fails to supply the required item or quantity, is unable to supply within the prescribed time, supplie s inadequate quantity, supplies items not conforming to the prescribed quality/specifications, or supply fro m such designated source is otherwise not available. iv) Upon activation of the standby supply arrangement, the successful bidder shall be bound to supply the required item/quantity against the supply order placed by the Buyer/Consignee within the prescribed deliv ery period and at the item-wise rates accepted under the GeM contract. v) Procurement of any item from the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC, as applicable, shall not constitute a breach or failure of the GeM contract on the part of the successful bidd er. The successful bidder shall have no right to claim any minimum assured quantity, compensation, loss o f profit or any other claim merely because the Buyer has procured the item from the designated source ins tead of the GeM bidder. vi) The actual quantity to be procured from the successful bidder shall depend upon the actual requiremen t of the Buyer/Consignee and the availability and satisfactory supply from the designated source. The quan tities indicated in the BOQ shall be treated as estimated quantities only and shall not constitute any comm itment or guarantee of procurement from the successful bidder. vii) The Buyer/Consignee shall be competent to decide whether the supply from the designated source is i nadequate, delayed, unavailable or otherwise not meeting the prescribed requirement, for the purpose of p lacing a standby supply order upon the successful bidder. 16. Activation of Standby/Alternate Supply: i) In the event of failure, non-availability, short supply, delayed supply, quality deficiency or any other disr uption in supply from the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC, as applicabl

e, the Buyer/Consignee may activate the standby supply arrangement and place a supply order upon the s uccessful GeM bidder for the required quantity. ii) The successful bidder shall supply the demanded quantity at the accepted GeM contract rates within the prescribed delivery period. Such supply order may be placed through GeM, e-mail, fax or any other author ized mode of communication. iii) The successful bidder shall not refuse or decline such supply order on the ground that the item was ordi narily intended to be procured from the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVI C. 17. Priority of Procurement The procurement mechanism shall ordinarily follow the following order: i) First Priority: Procurement from the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC, as applicable. ii) Second Priority: In the event of failure/non-availability/inadequate or unacceptable supply from the desi gnated source, procurement from the successful GeM bidder under the present contract. iii) Third Priority: In the event of failure of the activated GeM bidder to supply within the stipulated period, procurement from the local market or any other permissible source in accordance with the applicable rules /GeM terms and conditions. 18. Warranty Clause: - The followings clauses will applicable on the contract:- i. Warranty Period of the supplied ration items shall be as per their shelf/defined life mentioned in product’s label Information. ii. The packed Ration items supplied under the contract must conform to FSSAI/BIS/AGMARK or eq uivalent Specification and shall perform according to the said Specification in any climate and under all co nditions of storage and movement. iii. The goods/ stores supplied under the contract shall free from any type of defects. iv. Once the supplied stores are accepted by the Consignee’s BOO after physical examination, bef ore of consumption. This does not mean that the responsibility of supplier is over. At any point of time, the Buyer or his authorized representative may draw samples from the stocks supplied from locations where t hey are held at that point of time to confirm that the stocks supplied by the supplier are meeting the specif ication. Prior to drawl of such samples, the supplier will be intimated by the fastest means by the Consigne e/Buyer where the stocks are held to make available, the authorized representative of the supplier within t hree working days in whose presence the sample will be drawn. Failing which, the sample will be drawn un ilaterally and the decision of B.O.O on the same will be final and no representation in this regard will be ac cepted later. 19. If within the period of warranty, after analysis of the samples drawn as per Para 18 (IV) above, the goo ds are reported by the Buyer to have failed to meet the quality parameters as per the Specifications, the st ock will be declared as “Failed to Perform within Warranty Period”. The stocks shall be segregated at the l ocation. In the event of the supplies or part of it having been declared (during the period of warranty) as “F ailed to Perform within Warranty Period” by the Buyer or any officer acting on his behalf whose opinion as to whether or not the particular consignment is meeting the quality will be final. Hence, the opinion of the buyer or any officer acting on his behalf in regard to these charges will be final. A notification letter will be dispatched for such defect by the buyer. Seller is responsible to replaced the defected food items on free o f charge, within a maximum period of 15 days from the date of the notification letter dispatched for such d efected food items. It shall be the sole responsibility of the supplier to lift such segregated stocks declared failed to perform within a maximum period of 15 days. Failing which the stock shall be disposed off by a b oard of officers/officials.

20. The contracted rates will not be permitted to be enhanced during the currency of the contract as well as during extended currency period of the contract. 21. After completion of the currency of the contract if any decrease in total ordered quantity found agains t total estimated quantity reflected in the bid, clause effect on total value of the contract then seller will ha ve no right for any claim. 22. Bidders are required to upload valid FSSAI& applicable Trade license along with bid docu ments. 23. Participation by firm in bid shall be taken as confirmation on acceptance of all terms & Co nditions of this bid including amendment/corrigendum thereof. 24. a) In case the supply of ration items is rejected by the consignee. The replacement is to be provided b y the supplier within seven working days after rejection. If consignee accepts the replacement, LD (late del ivery charges) will be applicable for delayed period and for delayed quantity as per GeM GTC. b) In case the supply is delayed by supplier, LD will be applicable for the delayed period as per GeM G TC. c) In case the partial supply, LD (late delivery charges) will be applicable for the delayed period for the unsupplied quantity. d) If supplier fails to supply the items within the given period, consignee shall have the right to procee d for purchase of such store from local market as per market rates and seller shall have to reimburse such expenses within 15 days of intimation failing which buyer may forfeit required portion of ePBG under intim ation to seller in this case, LD shall not be applicable. 25. Failure of Standby Supplier In case the successful GeM bidder, after activation of the standby supply arrangement, fails to supply the d emanded quantity within the stipulated delivery period, the Consignee shall have the right to procure such items from the local market or any other permissible source at the prevailing market rates. Where the Buyer incurs any additional expenditure on account of such alternate procurement, the success ful bidder shall be liable to reimburse the additional expenditure, subject to the applicable provisions of the contract/GeM GTC, within 15 days of intimation. In case of failure to reimburse the amount within the stipulated period, the Buyer may recover the same fr om the Performance Security/PBG or any other dues payable to the seller, as permissible under the contra ct/GeM GTC. The provisions of this clause shall apply only when the standby supply arrangement has been activated an d a valid supply order has been placed upon the successful GeM bidder. 26. Experience criteria: - Second last line of the clause as mentioned at Sl. No. 03 of page-3, in instant bi d may be read as under: - Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having suppli ed some quantity during any of the financial year. 27. Seller shall submit sample of products which will be shown in the bid by the buyer in separate Annexur e showing name of items/Product, Nomenclature quantity. Normally sample will be in original packaging or packed in plastic containers. 28. The item wise rates would be fixed on the basis of L-1 Quoted value which has been mentioned/quoted by L-1 Supplier/Bidder on GeM portal leading to de crease/increase after RA (Reverse Auction) this issue should not become a reas on for cancellation of GeM Bid by L-1 Firm at any stage of contract or else EMD

would be forfeited by buyer. 29. Item-wise Rates for Standby Supply The bidder shall quote item-wise rates for all items included in the BOQ which a re proposed to be procured through the standby/alternate supply mechanism, i ncluding fresh vegetables, fresh fruits, milk & dairy products, meat, poultry, fish, millets and mustard oil, as applicable. The accepted GeM rates shall remain applicable whenever the Buyer/Consignee places a supply order upon the successful bidder for such items due to failure, n on-availability, short supply, delayed supply or unacceptable quality of supply fr om the designated Cooperative Society/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC. The bidder shall have no claim for any minimum quantity or assured procureme nt of such items. Payment shall be made only for the actual quantity supplied a nd accepted by the Consignee against a duly authorized supply order. 30. No Guaranteed Quantity The quantities of fresh vegetables, fresh fruits, milk & dairy products, meat, po ultry, fish, millets and mustard oil indicated in the BOQ, wherever applicable, ar e estimated quantities for the purpose of bid evaluation and procurement planning only. The Buyer does not guarantee procurement of the entire BOQ quantity from the successful GeM bidder. The actual quantity procured from the successful bidder may be less than, equal to or, subject to the applicable GeM provisions, increas ed from the estimated quantity, depending upon the actual requirement and th e availability and satisfactory performance of the designated Cooperative Societ y/Cooperative Institution/NAFED/KVIC. The successful bidder shall have no right to claim compensation, loss of profit or any other payment on account of non-utilization of the estimated quantity. 31. Seller must ensure that items/product should be the best quality (a pplicable to all items). 32. Seller has to supply the items as per approved samples only, however, if a ny specific item is not available in the market seller has to provide similar qualit y items for which seller has to deposit another 02 (Best quality) samples which will be decided by sample evaluation committee on the basis of rates and qualit y of the product. 33. In case the supply of seasonal fruits and vegetables, the supplier may provi de a list of available fruits and vegetables of same price range to the consignee for choose option and supplier will have supply that fruits/vegetables as the cas e may be. 34. In the financial document, Firms should not stamp and sign for making the process fairer and more confidential. 35. Procurement through MoU :- In addition to procurement through the Ge M Contract, the Buyer reserves the right to procure ration items through various Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) executed with FHQ, SSB, New Delhi. Such procurement shall be carried out in accordance with the applicable r ules, regulations, and provisions, as directed by FHQ, SSB, New Delhi. 36. Document Submission

All bidders must upload the required documents strictly in accordance with the GeM bid requirements. Proper indexing of all documents is mandatory for ease of verification, and an Index table must be provided at the beginning clearly indi cating the serial number, document name, and corresponding page numbers. D uplicate or repeated documents shall not be allowed. All uploaded docu ments must be clear, legible, and properly arranged, failing which, the bid may be liable for rejection. 37.
